svg.title: Stock XDJ-RX3 crossfader deck overlap and combined power
svg.desc: Three panels compare mirrored Deck A and Deck B gains over physical crossfader travel for MID, SHARP, and MID HALF. A lower strip in each panel shows combined uncorrelated power. MID stays near unity power, SHARP has both decks at full gain through most of travel, and MID HALF creates a center kill region.
svg.text: Deck overlap across physical crossfader travel
Mirrored stock tables · combined power = Deck A² + Deck B² · unity power shown dashed
Physical crossfader position · Deck A side (0) → Deck B side (1)
